title: Hearty Algerian Ackee Hash
description: Roasted ackee, melted cheese, and savory spices come together in this hearty Algerian-inspired brunch dish.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the ackee, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the ackee is heated through.
Meanwhile, prepare the temper mixture by whisking together 2 tablespoons of water and 1 teaspoon of paprika.
Add the temper mixture to the wok and stir to combine.
Transfer the hash to a serving dish and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Place the dish under the broiler until the cheese is melted and bubbly, about 2-3 minutes.
Cut the bread into small cubes and toast until crispy.
Sprinkle the toasted bread over the top of the hash and serve hot.
